mk_xstatus33.py DECLARE_FINAL OUT -- the frozen record of the round-29 priority re-extraction, as it ended (v4.33).

Every block r29-extract planned to re-extract with the final extractor on ALMA's flags (a crossing, a best limit, or a
statistic near the threshold, in any set) and what became of it, read from the lanes that ran them
(/data/paper_build/r29_extract/lanes/{F,S,B,B2}/state.json; the reproduction lanes N/N2 are not re-extractions) and from
r29-extract's declaration of the blocks it never queued (results/declare_final.json, kind 'infeasible').  A block is
`re-extracted` if any flagged lane finished it; otherwise its measured reason is recorded:
  legacy_replay        a pre-Cycle-3 block whose calibration must be replayed in full (x13 the raw size, measured)
  flags_need_nonlazy   ALMA's final flag version restores only on the non-lazy import, whose working set (x4.0-4.7 of
                       the raw data, measured) exceeds the volume; the two routes that fit were tried and failed
  flags_unrestorable   the final flag version is not row-conformant on any import
  disk_abort           every route tried exceeded the disk watchdog
  calibration_failed   a route that fits the disk ran and the calibration itself failed (not the flag restore)
  not_reached          (--freeze TIME) still being recalibrated when the fold was frozen
Refuses if a planned block is still queued or running (the record is made after the lanes drain) unless --interim.
